title: Alhambra trip
text: Our visit to the Alhambra was easily the highlight of our trip, and that is largely thanks to our incredible guide. From start to finish, they brought the rich history, intricate architecture, and hidden stories of the Nasrid Palaces, Alcazaba, and Generalife gardens to life.

title: Visit to the Alhambra
text: Although the price of the visit to the Alhambra seemed excessive to us for a couple (€160) I have to say that it has been a very good experience. My congratulations to the guide Jesús. At all times he explained the history to us with detail and great enthusiasm. Without a doubt, I would do it again for Jesús.
author: lararQ3458JE

title: Alhambra Palace
text:
We booked with Play Granada. Luckily we got there in reasonable time as I didn't read all the information on my email until we got to the Alhambra. We should have gone to the Play Granada office, a few miles away to collect our entry tickets. Completely my fault, luckily I was able to contact Eva in the office, who very kindly sent me the QR codes direct to my phone so we could gain entry. 
We spent a few enjoyable hours wandering around the palaces and gardens in the afternoon sun. Although busy, not over crowded due to the time of year.
There is a large rose garden, complete with pomegranite
